name: Gypsy Wagon
desc1: This wagon seems cramped with many baubles and strange wonders that
desc2: reside in here. You see several weapons, and strange pieces of metal
desc3: that you can only assume have been collected in the gypsy travels thus
desc4: far. The hair on the back of your neck tingles, reminding you that you
desc5: are not without supervision while in this encampment, and you had best
desc6: leave the wagon and trinkets that lay inside.
